thermal_qualification.protocol: Mixed functional protocols: baseline used older 2 CPU guard with Game-ready duty release; fresh normal-r3 used 1 CPU/default 90 instantaneous stop, while small-r2 selected optional 98. Fresh runs retained 65 launch, 85 C for three consecutive owned samples,10% duty through exit and no release marker.
thermal_qualification.mechanics_review: Independent source diff 205badf2 to 4c074319 changes only optional instantaneous threshold selection/receipt and CLI 90-or-98 default 90. Read the actual frozen-old unsupported-option RED and seven simulated-sensor/non-Godot GREEN cases, including default stop, brief bursts, sustained 85/95, immediate 98 and rejected 97.
thermal_qualification.limit: This is qualification of recorded sampling and guard mechanics only. One-Hz package samples do not bound unsampled peaks or establish component/hardware thermal safety. No timing or performance comparison is valid from these duty-controlled static captures.

limits: The broad orthogonal yard/property support, pale forecourt and plaza/road-strip geometry remain open.
The dark four-cell cared patch still reads as a square; this receipt does not accept its broader layout as finished.
Baseline precedes the already accepted care-edge shader correction. Policy appearance was judged outside cared support; this is not a policy-only pixel-difference experiment.
Static images with ambient spawner disabled and player god mode do not establish motion shimmer, combat-warning readability, live human play quality, performance or whole-city completion.
Interrupted prior after-s9 and small-r1 attempts are not accepted and must remain recorded separately.
